items.source: Return a filter that applies HTTP Basic Authentication to the request headers via HttpHeaders.setBasicAuth(String) and HttpHeaders.encodeBasicAuth(String, String, Charset).
items.translation: 返回一个过滤器，通过 HttpHeaders.setBasicAuth(String) 和 HttpHeaders.encodeBasicAuth(String, String, Charset) 将 HTTP Basic 认证应用于请求头。

items.source: Return a composed filter function that first applies this filter and then applies the given afterFilter.
items.translation: 返回一个组合的过滤函数，该函数首先应用此过滤器，然后应用给定的afterFilter。

items.source: Manipulate the filters with the given consumer.
items.translation: 使用给定的 Consumer 操纵过滤器。

items.source: Uses of ExchangeFilterFunction in org.springframework.test.web.reactive.server
items.translation: `org.springframework.test.web.reactive.server` 包中 `ExchangeFilterFunction` 的用法

items.source: Uses of ExchangeFilterFunction in org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client
items.translation: `org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client` 包中 `ExchangeFilterFunction` 的用法

items.source: Provides a reactive WebClient that builds on top of the org.springframework.http.client.reactive reactive HTTP adapter layer.
items.translation: 提供基于`org.springframework.http.client.reactive` 反应式 HTTP 适配器层的反应式WebClient。

items.source: Support for testing Spring WebFlux server endpoints via WebTestClient.
items.translation: 支持通过 WebTestClient 测试 Spring WebFlux 服务器端点。

items.source: Return a filter that generates an error signal when the given HttpStatusCode predicate matches.
items.translation: 返回一个过滤器，当给定的 HttpStatusCode 谓词匹配时生成错误信号。

items.source: Filter the exchange function with the given ExchangeFilterFunction, resulting in a filtered ExchangeFunction.
items.translation: 使用给定的 `ExchangeFilterFunction` 过滤交换函数，从而生成一个经过过滤的 `ExchangeFunction`。

items.source: Adapt the given request processor function to a filter function that only operates on the ClientRequest.
items.translation: 将给定的请求处理器函数适配为仅针对 `ClientRequest` 操作的过滤器函数。

items.source: Adapt the given response processor function to a filter function that only operates on the ClientResponse.
items.translation: 将给定的响应处理器函数适配为仅针对 `ClientResponse` 操作的过滤器函数。

items.source: Add the given filter to the filter chain.
items.translation: 将给定的过滤器添加到过滤器链中。

items.source:
Consume up to the specified number of bytes from the response body and
cancel if any more data arrives.
items.translation: 从响应体中读取指定数量的字节，如果收到更多数据则取消。

items.source: Add the given filter to the end of the filter chain.
items.translation: 将给定的过滤器添加到过滤器链的末尾。
